auto.note: Government meter tariff: ₹30 for the first 1.6 km, then ₹14 per km, and 1.5× from 11 pm to 5 am. Drivers often quote above the meter; the UI shows the meter fare plus a typical haggled range.

cab.note: Estimate for an economy app cab (Uber Go / Ola Mini class). Uber and Ola do not publish Hyderabad rate cards or offer a public price API, so this is base + per km + per minute, with a typical surge range by time of day. The real price is whatever the app shows.

shareAuto.note: Shared autos run informally on fixed corridors and are not guaranteed. Typical fares are ₹10–₹30 by distance.
